claim: AWS Managed Microsoft AD is compatible with multiple AWS services and with third-party applications; AWS cannot guarantee that every third-party application is or will stay compatible.
question: Can third-party Active Directory-aware applications use AWS Managed Microsoft AD?

values.display: multiple AWS services and third-party applications
unable to guarantee that any application

qualifiers.scope: AWS Managed Microsoft AD application compatibility

evidence.quote: AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory (AWS Managed Microsoft AD) is compatible with multiple AWS services and third-party applications.

Although AWS works with customers in an attempt to overcome any potential application installation challenges they might encounter, we are unable to guarantee that any application is or will continue to be compatible with AWS Managed Microsoft AD.

note: d081. The AWS service list (FSx for Windows, RDS, WorkSpaces, IAM Identity Center and others) is one-word list lines that cannot be quoted under M4.
